desc:
🍗Become FOOD and get cooked up... just like in Smarty's videos!
🍴At the end of recipes, get EATEN to unlock more recipes!
🪙Earn COINS to buy gears and effects!
🎬Play 'ROLEPLAY MODE' to access all morphs to record your own videos!

🔒Buy a PRIVATE SERVER for ADMIN! Record your own videos and use any command you want!

Version 2.5 UPDATE (30 October):
- Your name tag and particle effects now correctly carry over when morphing!
- Improved the 'Get Eaten' experience (player collision is now off and more!)
- When a Play Time Reward unlocks, confetti appears
- Fixed the cereal swordfight pop-up not appearing after 10 minutes (expect to see more players!)
- AND MORE!
